test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. Thus, Daphne cannot resist the opportunity to scold them about their behaviour.

B. The children have been annoying each other just before the meal starts.

C. Daphne's family mealtimes are usually tense because this is a time when conflicts in the family surface.

D. Also, they are rude about the food she has cooked, and Daphne gets upset by this.
solution:
The correct answer is '**CBDA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• Sentence C in the given question is the starting of an incident. This sentence is talking about **Daphne's family **which is usually tense because of conflicts.
 
• Sentence B will be the next sentence. Sentence C tells us about the conflicts so the children are also annoying and fight each other before the meal starts.
 
• Sentence D will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence. 
 
• Lastly, Sentence A will be used.
 
• Thus, the sequence becomes:
 
 
• C: Daphne's family mealtimes are usually tense because this is a time when conflicts in the family surface.
 
• B: The children have been annoying each other just before the meal starts.
 
• D: Also, they are rude about the food she has cooked, and Daphne gets upset by this.
 
• A: Thus, Daphne cannot resist the opportunity to scold them about their behaviour.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct Sequence:__ *Daphne's family mealtimes are usually tense because this is a time when conflicts in the family surface. The children have been annoying each other just before the meal starts. Also, they are rude about the food she has cooked, and Daphne gets upset by this. Thus, Daphne cannot resist the opportunity to scold them about their behaviour.*
